Welcome to Bali Eling Spirit

Your Divine Home to Transform

Start Your Meditation

Authentic Balinese Spiritual Wellness

A Legacy of Sacred Healing Across Generations

Bali Eling Spirit is a spiritual wellness sanctuary rooted in authentic Balinese wisdom, preserving a sacred legacy of healing passed down across generations through yoga & meditation. Internationally accredited, Bali Eling Spirit is a trusted institution for professional yoga teacher training, proudly offering its signature method, Bali Hatha Yoga – a unique yoga sequence and methodology created by the founder of Bali Eling Spirit.

“Bali Hatha Yoga was born from contemplation, practice, and revelation—a path of balance where the body becomes a temple, the breath becomes prayer, and movement becomes a medium of healing that unites the inner and outer universe.”

Sri Bhagawan Sriprada Bhaskara (Founder Bali Eling Spirit)
